tagline: A local coffee shop on Gate Parkway, open at half six with the lights already on.
voice: Homey and unhurried, with a bit of dry humour about the decor. Talks like a neighbourhood place that knows its regulars, not a chain.

ownerTodos: Send your drinks and food menu with prices. Two of the questions on the Visit page cannot be answered without it.
Confirm whether you have wifi, and whether customers can work there for a while.
Send photos: the counter, the seating, and a couple of drinks.
Tell us when the shop opened if you want that on the site.
If you post seasonal flavours anywhere, send the handle so it can be linked.
claimsAvoided: Nothing about service quality or friendliness. Reviews disagree sharply on it, and a site that promises a warm welcome is exactly what an unhappy customer quotes back at you.
No response to any criticism. One review complains at length; the site neither repeats it nor argues with it.
No prices. Not one source mentions a figure.
No wifi claim. Coffee shop sites always say it; no review here actually mentions it.
No founding year or 'serving Jacksonville since'. A review mentions a years-long relationship, which says nothing about when the shop opened.
No owner named, and no description of who they are beyond that the shop is owner-run.
No testimonials or review quotes. Review text is research, not copy.
